description: This file defines the class `ColumnStackedPlotAreaRenderer`, a specialized renderer for stacked column charts within the PDFsharp.Charting library, responsible for calculating column positions and rendering stacked columns.

classes.name: ColumnStackedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for stacked column plot areas, calculating positions for stacked columns in a chart.

methods.name: CalcColumns
methods.description: Calculates positions, width, and height for each stacked column in the chart.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Indicates that stacked columns are always considered inside the plot area.
